name: colibri
description: Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦
one_liner: A free program that lets you run huge, expensive AI 'brains' (the kind normally locked behind paid cloud APIs) directly on a computer you already own, by cleverly shuffling data between your hard drive, memory, and graphics card.
buyer: A law firm or clinic's IT lead who needs a powerful AI assistant but is legally barred from sending client data to outside cloud servers.
business_use_cases: A boutique law firm runs a large AI model entirely in-house to draft and review contracts, so no client document ever leaves the building.
A hardware reseller sells pre-configured 'AI-in-a-box' workstations loaded with Colibrì to hospitals and law firms that need private, on-prem AI.
A managed-IT consultancy offers a one-time setup + support package that installs and tunes Colibrì for a client's specific hardware.

money_ideas.idea: Sell preloaded 'sovereign AI' mini-PC appliances bundled with a mid-size model, targeting regulated industries.
Offer a paid setup-and-tuning consulting package for firms that want it installed on their own servers.
Sell an ongoing support/updates subscription for the appliance business above.

steal_this: Buy a mid-spec mini-PC, preload it with Colibrì and a capable open model, and sell it this weekend to a local law firm or clinic as a 'private ChatGPT, no subscription, no data leaves the building.'
